title: lgtm-ci results contract v1
description: One normalized result document per runner leg. Every test, coverage and audit runner writes results/<runner>/<matrix-key>/results.json in this shape; renderers (PR comment, step summary, Pages) and required-check verdicts read only this document. v1 may add optional properties; it never removes or retypes one (docs/workflow-contract.md, Results contract).

tool.description: Native tool that produced the counts (pytest, vitest, playwright, cargo-nextest, bats, osv-scanner, ...)

status.description: Leg verdict as seen by the runner. passed: exit 0 and no failed count; failed: a failed count or a non-zero exit; no-tests: exit 0 and nothing ran; error: the native report was missing or unparseable.

counts.description: Test (or finding) counts. Audits report findings under failed and total.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in whole milliseconds; 0 when the runner does not report one.

coverage.description: Present only when coverage was collected for this leg. Percentages 0-100. A metric the format does not measure (branches in line-only LCOV) is omitted, never 0.

artifacts.description: Files the runner left behind, relative to the job workspace. kind is a short lowercase label (report, coverage, html-report, junit, tap, comment, log).

source.description: Which lgtm-ci runner wrote the document and at which tooling revision.

matrix.description: Matrix coordinate of this leg; key is the matrix field (python-version) and value its value (3.12). Single-leg runners use key "matrix" and value "default".

exit_code.description: Native tool exit code when the runner captured one.
